title: Practice 3: за and под: going behind, under

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Она села и взялась за ___ (вёсла).

exercises.why: Prepositions used with the accusative case — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 61.  ·  «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.
